title: fix(service-settings): register the ai.test_embedder and knowledge.test handlers by default
body:
Fixes #24769

Clause-②: no

## What was wrong

Setup's AI "Test embedder" and Knowledge "Test connection" buttons both answered `400 SETTINGS_ACTION_FAILED`, with "No handler registered for action 'test_embedder' in 'ai'." and "No handler registered for action 'test' in 'knowledge'.". The manifests declare both buttons, and `aiTestEmbedderActionHandler` and `knowledgeTestActionHandler` are exported beside them. But `SettingsServicePlugin`'s default `actionHandlers` map registered only `mail.test`, `sms.test`, `storage.test` and `ai.test`.

Nothing registers either action later. At `a43405d59`, `git grep "registerAction("` finds only three registrations against a settings namespace outside this package: plugin-email (`mail`), service-sms (`sms`) and service-storage (`storage`). `@objectstack/service-knowledge`, `@objectstack/knowledge-memory`, `@objectstack/knowledge-ragflow` and `@objectstack/embedder-openai` never reference the settings service. So the PM's mechanism assumption M2 holds on the "no override" half: in this repository the stubs are the only possible handlers. `@objectstack/service-ai` is `edition: 'cloud'` and not in this repository, so whether it overrides `ai/test_embedder` is NOT MEASURED.

Landing: `packages/services/service-settings/src/settings-service-plugin.ts`, as the card expected. The defect is in the producer of the default map, not in a consumer.

## The fix

1. **Registration.** The default map now carries `ai: { test, test_embedder }` and `knowledge: { test }`. Override semantics are unchanged (M3, measured): a host's own `actionHandlers` still replaces the whole default map (`opts.actionHandlers ?? DEFAULTS`), and `SettingsService.registerAction` (a `Map.set`) still lets a plugin replace any one handler later. The option's docblock used to say only "the bundled `mail.test` handler is registered automatically". It now names the default set and says that passing the option replaces the whole map.
2. **Answer text (M2's second half).** No answer claimed outright that a connection or round trip was tested. Two answers did promise something false, though: "Mount @objectstack/embedder-openai + a knowledge adapter to exercise live calls" and "Mount @objectstack/knowledge-ragflow to exercise live calls". In this file that phrase follows the storage stub's pattern ("Mount @objectstack/service-storage to exercise live I/O"), and there it is true: service-storage overrides `storage/test` with a live probe. Neither embedder-openai nor knowledge-ragflow overrides anything, so mounting them never made either button live. Both phrases are removed. Every passing answer on a remote backend now says what it is: "This checks the form only — no embedding request was sent." for the embedder, and "This checks the form only — no connection was attempted." for Turso and RAGFlow. Two handler docblocks claimed a live-probe override "in `@objectstack/service-knowledge`". That is false, and they now state what was measured.

## What each button checks after this change

Neither button touches the network. Each merges the posted form state (a nested `values` object or a bare key map) over the saved values, then:

**AI → "Test embedder"** (`POST /api/settings/ai/test_embedder`)
- `embedder_provider` unset or `none`: `ok: false`, warning, "Embedder is disabled. Pick a provider to enable knowledge / RAG."
- any provider except `ollama` with no `embedder_api_key`: `ok: false`, error.
- `custom` / `azure` with no `embedder_base_url`: `ok: false`, error.
- otherwise: `ok: true`, info, "PROVIDER embedder settings are complete (model=MODEL). This checks the form only — no embedding request was sent."

**Knowledge → "Test connection"** (`POST /api/settings/knowledge/test`)
- `memory`: `ok: true`, warning, "In-memory adapter — no external service to probe. …" (unchanged).
- `turso` with no URL: `ok: true`, info, the reuse-the-tenant's-connection note, plus "This checks the form only — no connection was attempted."
- `turso` with a `libsql://` URL and no auth token: `ok: false`, error.
- `turso` with any other URL: `ok: true`, info, "Turso adapter configured (URL). This checks the form only — no connection was attempted." The existing sentence about `@objectstack/knowledge-turso` follows, unchanged.
- `ragflow` with no Base URL or no API key: `ok: false`, error.
- `ragflow` complete: `ok: true`, info, "RAGFlow adapter configured (URL). This checks the form only — no connection was attempted."
- any other adapter: `ok: false`, error.

The route is unchanged: `ok: true` answers 200 with the result, and `ok: false` answers 400 `SETTINGS_ACTION_FAILED` with the result under `error.details`.

## The pin, and the class it closes

`src/settings-default-action-handlers.pin.test.ts` reads every builtin manifest's `http`-kind `action_button` whose URL is the settings action route. It constructs the plugin with no options, runs `init()`, and drives each declared action through `runAction` on the service the plugin registered. Every handler the plugin registers is wrapped to record its own invocation. An action counts as honoured when a registered handler ran, or when `runAction` answered `ok` without one (its built-in `reset`, served for every namespace). The no-handler answer is neither. No message text is used as the discriminator.

The file holds a floor: the population must contain all seven current pairs. A second assertion checks that each button's route names its own namespace and id. Two HTTP-door cases replay the card's own two requests through `registerSettingsRoutes`. A new button declared without its handler, or a handler dropped from the default map, now goes red by name.

### Red before, green after

Run with the test commit `a66a74166` on the unchanged plugin (base `a43405d59`): `Tests 3 failed | 2 passed (5)`.

```
AssertionError: expected [ Array(2) ] to deeply equal []
+   "ai/test_embedder",
+   "knowledge/test",
AssertionError: expected 400 to be 200      (POST ai/test_embedder)
AssertionError: expected 400 to be 200      (POST knowledge/test)
```

With the fix, on `62b892d56` (the final head, `origin/main` `307ce4c4b` merged in): `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-settings exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2` reports `Test Files 54 passed (54)`, `Tests 899 passed (899)`. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-settings typecheck` exits 0. `tsc --listFiles` includes all three touched test files.

### Ablations (one-off, run at `c8dbf1395`; nothing permanent was added)

All three mutations went through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` in WRAP mode. Each anchor hit once, the blob changed, and the restore was proven: blob equal to HEAD, and `git diff HEAD` empty. The tests resolve this package's own source through relative imports, and `@objectstack/*` through the vitest source aliases, so no `dist/` is involved. Every ablation went red, the expected direction.

- **A: drop `knowledge: { test: knowledgeTestActionHandler }` from the default map.** `Tests 2 failed | 3 passed (5)`. The failures were `expected [ 'knowledge/test' ] to deeply equal []` and, at the HTTP door, `expected 400 to be 200`. Restored blob `716f8a5cda1d` equals HEAD.
- **B: append the old "Mount @objectstack/embedder-openai + a knowledge adapter to exercise live calls." to the embedder answer.** `Tests 1 failed | 27 passed (28)`: `expected 'openai embedder settings are complete…' not to match /to exercise live calls/`. Restored blob `bb1ad034d9ad` equals HEAD.
- **C: append the old "Mount @objectstack/knowledge-ragflow to exercise live calls." to the RAGFlow answer.** `Tests 1 failed | 24 passed (25)`: `ragflow: expected 'RAGFlow adapter configured (http://lo…' not to match /to exercise live calls/`. Restored blob `396195582b05` equals HEAD.

B and C keep the "no … was sent / attempted" sentence and add the old promise, so the negative pin fires on its own.

## Gates (local subset, on `62b892d56`)

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 67 commands from the 7 changed paths, against merge base `307ce4c4b`. Each was run with its exit code captured before any pipe.
- 66 exited 0. `node scripts/check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` first exited 3 because the shallow clone could not reach its pinned fixture commit. Once that commit was present it re-ran: exit 0, "48 cases pass".
- `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exited 3, `PREREQUISITE NOT MET`. It reads every package's `dist/`, and this worktree has built only the service-settings closure. NOT MEASURED locally; CI's `Lint & Repo Gates` runs it.
- `--ran` reconciliation: "67 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 66 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED (1 DERIVED from a recorded exit 3)", 0 UNRUN.
- Dependency closure built with `turbo run build --filter='@objectstack/service-settings...'` (16 tasks, exit 0).
- `test:repo` was not run locally; it belongs to CI (`Test Core`).

## Acceptance notes

- **Nothing in this repository reads the settings these buttons check.** That is the `knowledge` namespace and the `ai.embedder_*` keys: the only readers are service-settings' own manifests, tests and visibility evaluator. `@objectstack/knowledge-ragflow` and `@objectstack/embedder-openai` take their configuration from plugin constructor options. Whether a cloud runtime reads these values was not measured. Not filed: this is a read-only inference with no public-door measurement. Carrier: none.
- **`aiTestActionHandler`'s docblock is unverified.** It still says the real `ai/test` lives in `@objectstack/service-ai` and overrides the stub on `kernel:ready`. That package is cloud-edition, so this could not be measured here. Left untouched, because `ai.test` was already registered and is not this card's button.
- **Compatibility edge.** `init()` registers each default handler through `registerAction`, which throws `UnknownNamespaceError` for an unregistered namespace. A host that passes its own `manifests` without `knowledge`, and does not pass `actionHandlers`, would now fail at boot. The same edge already existed for `mail` / `sms` / `storage` / `ai`. Every in-repo site that passes `manifests` also passes `actionHandlers: {}`; the sites that pass no `manifests` get the builtin set, which includes `knowledge`.
- **Two fixture comments name an incomplete handler list.** `config-change-audit.test.ts` and `settings-admission-tenancy-posture.test.ts` describe the bundled handlers as `mail`/`sms`/`storage`/`ai`. The reason those comments give still holds; they are outside this card's file surface and were not edited.
- **Two contrast-control tests were replaced.** The embedder test in `ai.manifest.test.ts` and the RAGFlow test in `knowledge.manifest.test.ts` pinned the two removed "Mount … to exercise live calls" sentences, kept because those packages are built here. The packages do exist, but the promise was false for these buttons. The replacements pin the new property, and the AI live-call branches are still each exercised on their own.

## Risk and rollback

The change is additive registration plus answer text. Rollback is a revert of `c8dbf1395`: the two buttons go back to answering 400.

Changeset: `.changeset/24769-settings-test-handlers.md`, `@objectstack/service-settings` patch.
